title: Bibliography Manager — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Organizes sources and reference lists across papers and projects. The Bibliography Manager organizes sources and reference lists. It stores every source used across papers, tags them by project, generates the reference list in the required style, and tracks which sources are cited where. Duplicates are merged and missing citation details are flagged before the paper is submitted.
capabilities: Store sources across papers and projects
Tag sources by project and topic
Generate reference lists in the required style
Track which sources are cited where
Merge duplicates and flag missing details

Vary the length for flow.';const words=text.split(/\s+/).length;const sents=text.split('.').filter(s=>s.trim()).length;const avg=+(words/sents).toFixed(1);J({words,sentences:sents,avgWordsPerSentence:avg});assert(words===13&&sents===3&&avg===4.3,'readability');
